text:
ryan: Heads-up: BlueForge SI reported a customer-facing failure on the CloudArcade marketplace listing. They asked for an escalation path that doesn't open the full SEV-1 war room for every listing glitch. Can we define a lighter partner lane?
priya: Yes. Proposal: SEV-Lite for marketplace-only issues that affect listings/search (no data exfil, not customer compute failures). Triage inside shared channel first, escalate to full SEV if crash or PII risk.
alex: Agree. Suggested signal map:
- SEV-Lite: listing broken, search ranking mismatch, partner-UI errors (notify #pn-marketplace-lite)
- SEV-2: partner-impacting performance regressions (open war-room)
- SEV-1: customer data loss or infra outage (pager + war-room)
carla: Can we automate the initial triage? If monitoring shows 500 errors >5% across partner listings for 3 minutes, post to #pn-marketplace-lite and message oncall.
pager-bot: Rule triggered: 5xx-rate > 5% for partner=blueforge for 3m. Posting to #pn-marketplace-lite and paging marketplace-oncall.
ryan: Good. For shared channels: policy = only named liaisons + oncall + partner POCs. External users should be set to read-only.
priya: Channel name convention: #pn-<partner>-<scope>-sev, e.g., #pn-blueforge-listing-sev. Channel topic template: "Partner: BlueForge  Liaison: @priya  Oncall: @ryan  Scope: listings/search"
alex: War-room trigger for SEV-Lite: if triage cannot restore within 20 minutes OR customer impact > 3 customers. Then /ops warroom create --bridge shared --public false --owner @alex --severity SEV-Lite
carla: Add checklist for partner handoff in the channel pinned message: contact, escalation POC, who will post external comms, what automation to toggle.
ryan: We should also include hardware partners like NebulaRack when their infra is suspected. Add a quick runbook step: "if hardware_tower_id present in logs -> escalate to hw-partner-liaison and enable HW metrics feed"
pager-bot: Actionable: created incident ticket INC-2026-408 and linked warroom draft https://warrooms.redwood/2533330000-draft.
priya: I'll add the SEV-Lite doc to the partnerships runbooks and add BlueForge + NebulaRack POCs. Link: https://redwood.atlassian/partnerships/marketplace-sev-lite-runbook
carla: Let's do a 20-min tabletop tomorrow for BlueForge and NebulaRack. Proposed: 2026-04-02T17:00Z.
alex: I'll bring the oncall rotation and ops-bot playbook.
ryan: One more ask: log the shared channel membership in the ticket and set retention for 90 days.
priya: Noted. I'll update docs and create the channel with restricted posting.
pager-bot: Dry run scheduled: 2026-04-02T17:00Z. Invitations sent to participants.
